individual-data-points.explanation: Body weight, LW/BW and FW/BW scatter plots show individual mouse data points (dots/squares) overlaid on the mean ± SD bars.
Panel B contains gross photographs of dissected mice, not a quantitative plot.
Panel C shows H&E and Oil Red O micrographs, not a quantitative plot.
Panel D shows a 5mC dot blot and methylene blue staining image, not a quantitative plot.
Quantification of 5mC/methylene blue ratio is a bar graph with individual data points (dots) for each mouse overlaid.

The bottom bar graph quantifying TET1/TET2/TET3 over GAPDH shows individual data points (dots/squares) overlaid on the mean ± SEM/SD bars; the top part of the panel is a western blot image, not a plot.
